description_en: Creates a stack and triggers deployment
description_zh: 创建资源栈并触发部署
kebab_example: aliyun iacservice create-stack --client-token a65451293e64979ba7a4b573950217fe --source OSS --source-path oss::https://terraform-pipeline.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/code.zip --name stack-test --description Stack_to_create_ecs_and_related_resource_for_multiple_enviroments. --ram-role TestIacRole --working-directory /stack --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateStack

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Format: [0-9a-zA-Z-]{1,64}. We recommend that you use a UUID
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The creation source. Valid values:
- OSS: a template stored in Object Storage Service (OSS).
- IAC_SERVICE_MODULE: a template created in the automation service console
parameters.help_zh:
创建来源，取值
- OSS ：通过OSS对象存储的模板
- IAC_SERVICE_MODULE ： 自动化服务台中创建的模板
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The path of the configuration source. The value can be up to 1000 characters in length.
- If the source is OSS, set this parameter to oss::<file link>. The file must be a ZIP file. Example: oss::https://terraform-pipeline.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/code.zip.
- If the source is IAC_SERVICE_MODULE, set this parameter to the template ID. Example: mod-xxxxx
parameters.help_zh:
配置来源的路径值，不超过 1000 个字符
- 来源为 OSS 时，取值为 oss::<文件链接>，必须为 zip 文件，例如 oss::https://terraform-pipeline.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/code.zip
- 来源为 IAC_SERVICE_MODULE 时，取值为<模板Id>，例如: mod-xxxxx
parameters.name: source_path

parameters.help_en: The stack name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). The name cannot start or end with a hyphen, underscore, or period
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈名称，长度为 2~128 个字符，允许大小写字母、数字、中文、短横线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.），且不能以短横线、下划线、半角句号开头或结尾
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: Stack to create ecs and related resource for multiple enviroments.
parameters.help_en: The description of the stack. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈描述信息，不超过256个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The RAM role to be assigned to the task. This role is used to automatically continue the execution of scheduled tasks during automatic triggers or offline scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 选择一个RAM角色授权给任务，用于在自动触发或者离线情况下自动完成计划任务的继续执行
parameters.name: ram_role

parameters.help_en: The working directory where the configuration file is located. Enter / if the file is in the root directory. Example: config/ or /
parameters.help_zh: 配置文件所在的工作目录（如在根目录下则输入 /），如：config/ 或 /
parameters.name: working_directory
